thumbnail.caption: J.B. Hunt leaders and longtime employees mark the 65th anniversary of the company at a Nasdaq Opening Bell ceremony in New York City. The group included drivers, maintenance technicians, office employees and executives whose service spans multiple decades of the company's history.
